title: Volxten's Skin Fix
description: Pretty self explanatory...  But, this is a skin fix for Release 1.0
body:
Hi this is a SUPER basic skin fix (aka a mod that allows you to use your skin with older versions, in this case 1.0)

this DOES NOT require the modloader despite whats stated, it's a direct jar mod (meaning that you add it/combine it with the minecraft jar file)

this uses [Mineskin](https://mineskin.eu/) for retrieving skins since i didnt want to use uuids

ok thats it bye :3
